name: Field-Service Estimate Engine
problem: A contractor or service operator needs a consistent estimate/range from scope and measurements, with transparent cost build-up, margin assumptions and uncertainty rather than a hand-waved price.
use_when: build a contractor estimate from this scope
turn these measurements into an estimate
give me a rough customer range
calculate margin and price for this job
inputs: Service key and quantity/scope; optional property, measurements/inputs, site-verification state, tax, travel and other direct costs.
outputs: Estimated cost, sell price or range, confidence, assumptions, inclusions/exclusions and site-review state, with revision/proposal lineage available downstream.
pricing: No approved external machine price/payment path was found. Internal service-template prices/cost assumptions are estimation inputs, not the price of this machine capability.
confirmation: Rough estimate generation does not authorize sending a proposal, accepting work or creating a customer obligation. Proposal/payment actions retain separate authority gates.
payment_authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path for external estimator access.
invocation_status: LIVE: public machine discovery docs plus central Evercraft MCP matching. Commercial execution remains verification-gated; no automatic checkout or payment obligation.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
